Fireworks with white and golden sparks explode in the night sky. (2) A young man in a white T-shirt, black cap, and sunglasses hanging on his shirt points towards the camera in a medium close-up, speaking directly to the audience against a blurred outdoor background. (3) A coastal scene displays volcanic basalt columns on a cliffside by the ocean. A circular inset shows the man continuing to speak. (4) The man, now wearing a green patterned shirt and a red helmet, walks along the shoulder of a paved road next to pine trees as a white truck passes by. (5) In a close-up, the man wears sunglasses and a red helmet, speaking with an emotional facial expression against a gray, overcast sky. (6) A digital screen displays flight information for 'Uni Air' and 'Mandarin Airlines' going to Taipei. The man is shown looking up with a worried or frustrated expression. (7) An aerial drone shot captures a long, multi-span bridge stretching across light blue seawater with a few cars moving on it. (8) A wide shot shows the iconic vertical basalt columns of Penghu next to a small pool of green water, where two people stand in the foreground. (9) A drone shot follows the man riding a blue motor scooter along the long bridge over the ocean. (10) The man runs across a wide, sandy beach under a bright sky. (11) Finally, the man stands on a white nautical lookout point, leaning on a blue railing and looking out at the rocky shoreline and the blue sea.
